title: Component formula for the curried iterated Hom differential

from.place: iterated Hom differential, one product component

statement: For any cochain complexes K,L,M of sheaf modules over R and integers n,t, put T=Tot(K tensor L). The iterated Hom differential from n to n+1 followed by the chosen currying map and the projection to internal Hom(T^t,M^(t+n+1)) equals the degree-n currying map followed by its t-th projection and postcomposition with d_M, minus (-1)^n times the degree-n currying map followed by its (t+1)-st projection and precomposition with d_T. This is an identity in one internal Hom factor, not an equality into the full Hom complex.

proof.text: Expand the outer and inner Hom differentials on localized pure tensors in the summand K^p tensor L^q, p+q=t. The defining currying equation yields d_M(f(x)(y))-(-1)^(p+n)f(x)(d_L y)-(-1)^n f(d_K x)(y). The total tensor differential sends x tensor y to d_K x tensor y+(-1)^p x tensor d_L y. The integer sign addition identity equates these expressions with the displayed postcomposition and signed precomposition terms. Bilinearity extends the equality before sheafification; the sheafification adjunction and coproduct property extend it to the total tensor term, and equality on all localized sites gives equality in this internal Hom factor.

theorem homTensorDegreewiseMap_iteratedDifferential_component
    (K L M : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) (n t : ℤ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    let T := CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
    (homComplex (R := R) K (homComplex (R := R) L M)).d n (n + 1) ≫
        homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M (n + 1) ≫
          homTensorProjection R T M (n + 1) t (t + (n + 1)) rfl =
      (homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫
        homTensorProjection R T M n t (t + n) rfl ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (𝟙 (T.X t)) (M.d (t + n) (t + (n + 1)))) -
      n.negOnePow • (homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫
        homTensorProjection R T M n (t + 1) (t + (n + 1)) (by omega) ≫
          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (T.d t (t + 1)) (𝟙 (M.X (t + (n + 1)))))
